meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama - Unitary National Jurisdiction (no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic) with Anglo-American-style corporate statute influence under Ley 32 de 1927; territorial taxation; unitary jurisdiction.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Corporate law: Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas) as amended; registry regulations: Real Ejecutivo Decreto No. 348 de 1987; AML/CFT: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 and SSNF Resolution No. SSNF-001-2018; UBO Register: Ley 129 de 23 de diciembre de 2020 and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 3 de 7 de enero de 2021; economic substance: Ley 254 de 2020 and Decretos 103/104 de 2021; insurance auxiliaries: Decreto Ley 12 de 2003; maritime oversight: Ley 7 de 1998 (Autoridad Marítima de Panamá).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and authenticated copy of the foreign corporate UBO's charter, incumbency, and good standing certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry / competent authority of the UBO's country of organization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarially certified passport or national identification pages of each individual UBO and officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent issuing authority of the UBO's nationality plus Panamanian notary for signature certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Legal Existence for any corporate shareholder of the Panamanian S.A.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation (traducción certificada) of all non-Spanish legal instruments in the incorporation file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian court-qualified translator with notarial safeguard
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial authentication in Panama; source documents must retain the original Hague Apostille or consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening prior to onboarding: (1) verify against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, and the Panamanian UAF restrictive list; (2) identify PEPs and their close associates per Ley 23 de 2015 art. 20 and SSNF Resolution 001-2018; (3) apply enhanced due diligence (EDD) for PEPs, high-risk countries, and unusual source-of-wealth scenarios; (4) run conflicts-of-interest checks against the insurance auxiliaries regime under Decreto Ley 12 de 2003, including any disqualification of the marine surveyor from acting as adjuster for a related insured; (5) document all screening results, assign a risk rating, and retain records for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Online Certificate of Name Search System (Sistema de Certificado de Nombre) at https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa; subsequent subject registration via the Superintendencia General de Sociedades (SGS) portal at https://www.sgs.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registry language is Spanish; corporate names must be expressed in Roman script and, where the desired name uses foreign words, a Spanish transliteration or descriptive catchword may be mandatory. The proposed name must not be identical or phonetically identical to any registered name, and must not convey a regulated activity unless the appropriate prior ministerial approval is exhibited. The corporate object clause (objeto social) must be drafted in Spanish to define the marine survey, maritime claims inspection, and insurance loss assessment scope.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Banking / Banca (reserved to licensed banks, Superintendencia de Bancos)
Seguros / Reaseguros / Insurance (reserved to licensed insurers under SMVS)
Fondo de Inversión / Mutual Fund / Valores (requires securities regulator approval)
Comisión / Concesión (requires ministerial or municipal franchise approval)
Gobierno / Nacional / Presidencia / República (official and sovereignty-sensitive tokens)
Notaría / Abogado / Legal (reserved to regulated legal professionals)
Zona Libre / Free Zone (requires Zona Libre de Colón or Panama Pacifico authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is identical, phonetically similar, or misleadingly similar to an existing registration, the Registry issues a formal rejection. The requesting attorney may (1) renegotiate the corporate name by filing an alternate variant with geographic, activity, or numeric identifiers within the same reservation window; (2) file a written reconsideration (recurso de reconsideración) with the Director General del Registro Público within five (5) business days of notification; or (3) file an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Registry's superior body, with final judicial recourse before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia. In practice, a rapid alternate-name refiling is the most efficient remedy; any approved reservation can be renewed for one further 30-day period by fresh filing before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible as the statutory domicile and registered-agent address only if the mandatory Panamanian registered agent (an active attorney under Law 32 of 1927, art. 7) maintains a verifiable physical address in Panama. A serviced office or virtual executive suite located in Panama City is generally accepted for a low-risk marine survey administration hub. Pure mail-forwarding without any operational footprint is incompatible with the economic-substance obligations of Ley 254 de 2020 and the SGS substance guidelines for licensed service providers; the company must evidence real contracts, client files for hull and cargo claims inspections, insurance-survey reports, and local accounting records if the substance test is assessed in Panama.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15-25% risk in year one: SGS has adopted risk-based unannounced inspections (visitas de inspección) and prioritizes entities with shared registered addresses, unsupported UBO filings, or licensed activities. The inspection probability increases to above 40% if the UBO return is late or if the registered address hosts more than ten corporate entities.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Articles 1–20, as amended) governing the Sociedad Anónima, supplemented by Ley 14 de 2020 regarding bearer shares, registered agents, and transparency obligations; registry procedure governed by the Reglamento General del Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección General de Registro, Sección de Personas Jurídicas, Ciudad de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Pacto Social, Articles of Incorporation) executed before a Panamanian Notary and subsequently registered in the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a Sociedad Anónima may be formed without disbursed capital and without a bank escrow account. The charter fixes authorized capital in nominal shares; bearer shares are prohibited since 2015 and all issued shares must be nominative and disclosed to the Registry under Ley 14 de 2020.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial subscription to the Corporation's capital shares as set forth in the Escritura Pública be accepted; that the registered office be fixed at Avenida Samuel Lewis, Ciudad de Panamá, with firm counsel designated as Resident Agent; that the following officers be appointed: President, Vice-President, and Secretary-Treasurer, each to serve for the statutory term; that the corporate purpose of vessel hull and cargo marine surveying be formally approved; that the President be authorized to present the deed to the Registro Público, obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación, and secure all industry and environmental permits; and that a bank account resolution and signing authorities be delegated to the Secretary-Treasurer. Unanimously adopted at the first meeting of the Board of Directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and execution of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito (Notary Public of the Circuit), Ciudad de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name, together with two alternates, to the Registro Público name availability database; once the name is cleared, the founding shareholders or a single lawful representative shall appear before a Panamanian notary to execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución, which must state the corporate purpose, capital stock, officer structure, and resident agent clause. The notary delivers the testimonio (first certified copy) for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of each subscribing shareholder's passport or corporate good-standing certificate
Certificate of name availability or Registry 'no opposition' validation
Draft Pacto Social prepared by Panamanian counsel
Signed written acceptance of office by the initial directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or opposed, file an amended name application with the Registry; if the notary raises formal defects, correct the deed and re-execute before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the corporation with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (online submission via Título filing counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Escritura Pública, the name availability certificate, and the official tariff receipt to the Personas Jurídicas section; the Registry examiner assigns a corporate id (ficha), verifies the deed against legal requirements, and issues the Certificate of Registration. The certified registered copy is then used for all subsequent permits.
required_dossiers: Notarized testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Official filing cover sheet signed by counsel
Payment receipt for the statutory registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner issues observations, counsel must file an addendum or Fe de Erratas before the notary and resubmit within the administrative term; reapplications must cure the cited formal defect and no new fee accrues if presented within ten working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Aviso de Operación and commercial patent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá — Tesorería Municipal, Section of Commercial Licenses
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the local operating notice and commercial patent, declaring the office address and the marine surveying activity. The municipality verifies zoning and premises legality, issues the patente municipal, and activates the annual municipal tax obligation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública
Registry ficha (corporate legal identity card)
Lease contract or property title covering the registered office
Fire inspector certificate for office premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the municipality questions zoning or asks for supplementary floor documents, obtain a provisional aviso de operación while the completed lease and occupancy certificate are submitted; municipal arrears, if any, must be settled to continue the license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer registration with the Dirección General de Ingresos (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) Service Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as a taxpayer before the DGI, obtain the RUC number and require supporting tax identification certificates for future invoicing and customs/maritime procedures. The DGI creates the taxpayer profile based on the corporate name, domicile, activity code ISIC 5222, and director data.
required_dossiers: Registry ficha and certified copy of the registered deed
Municipal Aviso de Operación issued by the municipality
DGI Form 610 (Registro de Contribuyente) duly signed
RUC application signed by the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is delayed or contains mismatched data, attend the DGI taxpayer service center to correct the corporate name or address, and resubmit the signed form; internal DGI queries are answered in writing within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Auxiliary Maritime Services Provider with the Panama Maritime Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) — Dirección General de Marina Mercante
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the auxiliary maritime services registration authorizing the company to act as a marine claims surveyor and vessel hull/cargo inspection firm for underwriters. The application must present an operational survey plan, an appointed licensed senior surveyor, and evidence of professional liability insurance; AMP evaluates the applicant's technical capacity and may conduct an in-office compliance interview.
required_dossiers: RUC and municipal operating patent certificates
Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública and ficha
Curriculum vitae and professional license of the surveyor-in-charge
Professional indemnity/P&I insurance certificate
Operational service manual covering hull damage and cargo inspection protocols
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AMP issues a requerimiento for supplementary technical documentation, provide corrected material within the stated grace period (usually 30 days); an adverse denial may be contested through an internal reconsideration petition, while the company may lawfully continue desk-based advisory services without necessitating a vessel-call permit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental impact declaration with the Ministry of Environment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the environmental registration form for an office-based professional services operation. As the marine surveyor performs assessments on third-party vessels and does not install fixed industrial plant, a Category I registration suffices; MiAMBIENTE issues an environmental registry certificate that validates the premises for municipal and maritime licensing.
required_dossiers: Copy of any used municipal patents
Formulario de Registro Ambiental signed by the legal representative
Location map (croquis) and office floor plan
RUC certificate confirming the corporate taxpayer status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On receipt of a technical observations letter, respond within fifteen working days with a revised declaration; failure to cure triggers an inspection visit, after which a further ten-day correction period is granted before final registry approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire safety certification and structural/occupational clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá and Junta Técnica de Ingeniería y Arquitectura (JTIA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Schedule a fire inspector visit for the registered office, install extinguishers, signage, and access control, and obtain the annual Certificado de Prevención de Incendios. Where the leased premises exceed the JTIA threshold, obtain an occupancy/structural certificate confirming load-bearing capacity; occupational health clearance is issued by the CSS Department of Professional Risks on review of the workplace risk plan.
required_dossiers: Municipal Aviso de Operación and patent receipt
Fire prevention plan and equipment installation records
Structural calculation or existing engineer certificate for the premises
Workplace health and safety policy signed by the employer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct said non-conformities within ten business days and request a re-inspection; a provisional occupancy certificate may be issued where only cosmetic fire-lane or signage items remain pending, followed by final certification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) — Dirección General de Marina Mercante, Auxiliary Maritime Services Registry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Empresas de Servicios Auxiliares Marítimos y Peritaje de Daños a Casco y Carga (Auxiliary Maritime Services and Marine Claims Surveying Company License)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I — Declaración de Registro Ambiental (low-impact registration); full EIA Study expressly not required because the activity is office-based professional surveying without fixed industrial installations at company premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office operations discharge only municipal-sanctioned sanitary wastewater; any temporary field sampling equipment must comply with MiAMBIENTE air emission guidance limiting exhaust VOC content to 500 mg/m³ maximum; all non-domestic solid waste, including chemical sampling residues, must be handled through an authorized transporter under the National Hazardous Waste Protocol (Ley 38 de 2010); diesel generator use, if any, is capped at 500 operating hours per year with permit registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Annual fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering the registered office; JTIA structural load inspection certificate required for leased floors exceeding 1,000 m² or for retrofit of mezzanine survey stations; occupational health clearance (Salud Ocupacional) issued by the CSS Department of Professional Risks confirming adequate lighting, ventilation, first-aid and ergonomic provisions for drafting survey reports.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; official portal: 'Portal E-Tax' (https://etax.mef.gob.pa) supported by the DGI public website (www.dgi.gob.pa), with the mandatory 'Sistema de Facturación Electrónica' module for digital fiscal clearance. Panama is a unitary tax jurisdiction with no sub-national income tax; RUC administration is exclusively national.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Notarize the incorporation deed of the Sociedad Anónima and register the deed, by-laws and officer appointments with the Registro Público de Panamá, appointing a resident agent (agente residente) with a Panamanian registered address (no minimum paid-in capital). Step 2: File the Aviso de Operación and obtain the municipal annual operating license (patente) applicable to the tax jurisdiction where the office is physically located. Step 3: Apply to the DGI through the Portal E-Tax for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes), attaching the registered deed, resident-agent appointment, directors' and beneficial-owners' identification, and proof of registered address; a non-resident-owned S.A. may complete and maintain the entire process through a licensed Panamanian lawyer or CPA. Step 4: Simultaneously activate ITBMS registration and obtain the DGI e-invoicing 'habilitación' (fiscal authorization), together with payroll and non-resident withholding registrations. Step 5: Obtain the maritime surveyor professional license required by the Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) for vessel/cargo inspection activities and, if a preferential regime (SEM under Law 41 of 2007, free-zone license, or Law 76 of 2019 relocation incentive) is intended, file the corresponding application with the competent authority so the operative RUC record reflects the applicable regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope / Tax_Exempt_Zone — the S.A. is a per-se taxable corporation (no pass-through election) subject to Panamanian income tax only on Panamanian-source income; marine survey fees earned by a Panama S.A. from foreign underwriters for surveys of non-Panamanian vessels or cargo in international transit are treated as extraterritorial income outside the territorial tax base, and can be further ring-fenced under a SEM or free-zone license.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not enact US-style check-the-box or general hybrid-mismatch elections; the S.A. is mandatorily taxed at entity level under the territorial system. Available statutory opt-in regimes: (i) SEM (Sede de Empresa Multinacional) under Law 41 of 2007, exempting qualifying offshore services and headquarter activities from income tax and ITBMS; (ii) Law 76 of 2019 relocation incentives, granting temporary income-tax, dividend and ITBMS exemptions for companies moving their statutory domicile to Panama; (iii) free-zone / Área Económica Especial del Pacífico licenses excluding extraterritorial transactions from ITBMS; and (iv) the Law 66 of 2010 simplified fixed-quota regime for micro taxpayers with annual revenue at or below USD 36,000. Elections require prior DGI or MICI/SEM authority approval, and a marine surveyor may not retroactively elect zero-rating on taxable domestic survey work.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — Panama's national value-added tax on the transfer of movable goods and the rendering of services in the Republic of Panama, governed by Law 8 of 2010 and subsequent amendments.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold: every person (including the Panamanian S.A. of a marine surveying business) habitually rendering taxable services in Panama must obtain the RUC and register for ITBMS before starting operations; micro taxpayers under Law 66 of 2010 whose annual gross income does not exceed USD 36,000 may opt for the simplified fixed monthly quota instead of the full monthly ITBMS return cycle.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama operates a phased mandatory e-invoicing regime: all active taxpayers must issue 'factura electrónica' through the DGI Portal E-Tax or through a DGI-certified software provider (PIS), submitting invoices to DGI in near-real time for fiscal validation, time-stamping and issuance of an electronic authorization code/QR — no paper invoice is valid for input-tax credit or expense deduction. Taxpayers must also maintain digital signature certificates and file the electronic sales and purchases ledgers through the e-Tax portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% ITBMS) applies to (i) exports of movable goods physically leaving Panama under a customs export declaration, and (ii) services rendered to non-resident persons where the service is not used, consumed or economically enjoyed in Panama and is not connected with tangible property located in Panama at the time of performance. A marine cargo/hull surveyor can claim 0% only if the foreign underwriter/payer is the sole beneficiary, the survey report and economic benefit are delivered and enjoyed abroad, and the inspected vessel or cargo is in international transit; surveys of Panamanian-flagged domestic traffic, port operations, or Panamanian insurers' risks remain taxable at 7%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Documento Único de Aduana — DUA) or the equivalent DGI service-export registry record identifying the transaction as an export
Bill of Lading and/or Air Waybill evidencing the international movement of the inspected vessel/cargo (for cargo survey files)
Commercial invoice and the detailed marine survey/inspection report naming the foreign principal and the insured risk/cargo
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank credit voucher) or equivalent wire-transfer evidence from the non-resident underwriter/payer
Signed service contract with the foreign underwriter/broker stipulating place of payment, offshore use, and exclusive economic benefit abroad
DGI zero-rated e-invoice (factura electrónica coded as 'exportación') bearing the DGI validation code, plus the corresponding export ledger disclosure
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI conducts targeted post-clearance audits of zero-rated export claims; non-substantiation, missing documentation, or recharacterization of a domestic survey as an export triggers retroactive assessment at 7% ITBMS plus moratory interest (annual interest indexed to the Panamanian banking rate) and administrative fines of up to 100% of the omitted tax. Intentional false export declarations or fraudulent use of zero-rating may be prosecuted as criminal tax evasion (defraudación tributaria) under the Panamanian Penal Code with imprisonment of 2 to 5 years, and expose the taxpayer to cancellation of its e-invoicing 'habilitación', loss of free-zone/SEM benefits, and inclusion in the DGI's public registry of defaulting or sanctioned taxpayers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the sole prudential supervisor of banks, trust companies, and payment service providers; Banco Nacional de Panamá functions exclusively as fiscal agent of the State. Panama operates without a traditional central bank and without any domestic currency issuance or monetary authority, and there is consequently no FX administration licence, approval window, or exchange-control department.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized: the United States Dollar is legal tender and the exclusive clearing currency. Both capital and current account transactions are freely convertible; there are no restrictions on opening foreign-currency accounts, no limitations on profit or dividend repatriation, and no treasury authorisation for external transfers. Withholding tax on Panama-source dividends to non-resident shareholders (5% plus the 2% tax on dividends paid out of taxable income) is a fiscal charge and not an FX convertibility hurdle. Territorial-source rules apply for income tax, and foreign-source maritime survey fees earned abroad may be remitted offshore without any Panamanian exchange-control barrier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Panamanian law imposes no export proceeds surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no balance-of-payments reporting obligation for private-sector receipts. Marine survey fees, claim inspection fees, and underwriter remittances received in USD, EUR, or GBP may be retained in any currency, applied to working capital, or transferred offshore without time limit or central bank approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (corporate current account for survey fee collections, payroll, and claims settlement disbursements)
Operational Account (international trade settlement and multi-currency treasury for EUR/USD/GBP flows)
Operational Account (corporate operating account with digital banking and regional correspondent access)
Capital Escrow Account (statutory capital sufficiency and claim-fund administration clearing)
Operational Account (offshore private-client flows and reinsurance claim payables)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a complementary rail only; Low as a primary settlement infrastructure. Panama does not maintain a dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing law; non-bank payment providers require SBP registration under the 'Empresa de Servicios de Pago' regime, and an offshore EMI (e.g., Wise Business) cannot be licensed as a bank-equivalent credit institution in Panama. Wise is operationally viable for low-value disbursements below USD 50,000 to foreign survey subcontractors and for receiving underwriter fee remittances through its virtual IBAN facilities, but it cannot replace a tier-1 Panamanian bank account for claim escrows, capital preservation, or SBP-supervised AML compliance. The enterprise should maintain a local bank account as the master account and use Wise strictly as an ancillary payout rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical in-branch KYC interview is mandatory for at least one director, the legal representative, or the beneficial owner at the initial account opening of a newly formed Sociedad Anónima. Remote onboarding is accepted only where the entity already enjoys a qualifying relationship with the same banking group and appoints a resident agent holding an apostilled power of attorney; in all other cases SBP-regulated banks require personal appearance at the Panama branch, presentation of the legalised corporate registry certificate (Registro Público), the registered shareholder ledger, and a sworn source-of-funds declaration. The marine survey company must therefore plan one principal visit to Panama or mandate a Panamanian counsel to appear as attorney-in-fact.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregistered beneficial owner or incomplete shareholder register at registry due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legalised and apostilled share register (Libro de Registro de Acciones), certified Certificate of Good Standing from Registro Público, notarised Certification of Beneficial Owner form, sworn source-of-wealth statement, and passport copies of the UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee directors or omnibus signatory authority flagged during screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Management and dirección agreement evidencing actual directors' engagement, marine surveyor professional licence certificate issued by the Panama Maritime Authority (Autoridad Marítima de Panamá), clean criminal-record certificate for each nominee, and the bank's KYC form naming the sole economic beneficiary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Invoice and purpose-code mismatch between marine survey fees and insurance claim settlement flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying survey retainer contracts, detailed inspection and loss-adjustment reports, marine insurance policy excerpts naming the entity as appointed surveyor, ISIC 5222 business narrative, and evidence of statutory registration with the Panama Maritime Authority or Superintendencia de Sujetos no Financieros for designated non-financial professionals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and geographic risk driven by counterparties in high-risk shipping registries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions-screening results for all vessel owners, brokers, and reinsurers; counterparty risk assessment files; the entity's written AML/CFT manual; and the correspondent bank's KYC questionnaire cleared with evidence of end-client inspection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Territorial-tax ambiguity: suspected tax-residency avoidance or divergent offshore income claims
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DGI (Dirección General de Ingresos) taxpayer registration certificate, Panama Maritime Authority operating licence, physical office lease and staff payroll records evidencing economic substance, local vessel inspection reports, and prior-period Panamanian tax returns and payment receipts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder equity capital or working capital via SWIFT MT103 from the underwriter parent to the designated tier-1 Panamanian bank using the Balance of Payments purpose description 'Foreign Direct Investment in Services Sector' or 'Shareholder Loan' in the wire remarks. Verification procedures require the bank's onboarding file to contain the corporate resolution authorising account opening, the shares ledger, and the contributing shareholder's source-of-funds statement from its original bank. For inward premium and claim-settlement remittances from marine insurers, use the MT103 narrative 'Insurance Surveyor Fees / Marine Claims Inspection Fees' accompanied by the survey engagement letter, the policy reference number, and the claims settlement memorandum; enhanced due diligence documentation must be retained for intraday or cumulative credits exceeding USD 100,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 to any SBP-recognised correspondent bank for disbursements to reinsurers, subcontracted surveyors, legal counsel, and classification societies. For contracts integrating physical cargo movement with marine survey services, a commercial letter of credit (L/C) at sight may be opened through Banistmo or BAC International under UCP 600 terms; in practice the survey entity prefers MT103 payment against presentation of the survey certificate. Domestic supplier payments are cleared domestically through the SBP-operated ACH Panama (Cámara de Compensación Bancaria) on a T+1 basis. Wise Business serves as a supplemental low-value rail for reimbursements to remote subcontractors below USD 50,000. No state approval is required for capital or trade outflows; the bank's compliance department retains the invoice and underlying contract for file documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts in USD/EUR and USD/GBP executed through the tier-1 local bank's international treasury desk
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) denominated in EUR, GBP, or JPY referenced against the USD
Cross-currency interest rate swaps between USD and EUR or GBP for long-dated reinsurance premium flows
FX vanilla options purchased from international investment-grade counterparties to hedge claims-denominated currency exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Anual de Sociedad Anónima)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year rule: payment window opens January 1 and closes March 31; newly incorporated S.A.s pay the franchise tax for the registration year at incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment after March 31 incurs a US$50 surcharge (US$350 total); failure to pay for three consecutive years triggers automatic dissolution and strike-off by the Registro Público; the company is denied Paz y Salvo and cannot obtain Registry certificates or effect corporate filings until regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: filing due within 30 days after the annual anniversary of the corporation's registration; any share transfer or UBO change must be reported within 30 days of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of up to US$10,000 under Law 23 of 2015; the DGI may withhold Paz y Salvo and block corporate transactions before the Registro Público while the declaration remains outstanding.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta, Form 1402) — required only if Panamanian-source income is derived
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within three months of fiscal year-end (March 31 for calendar-year taxpayers); automatic two-month electronic extension to May 31; an S.A. with exclusively foreign-source income has no filing obligation under Panama's territorial tax system.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines range from US$50 to US$500 plus 10% annual interest on unpaid tax; the DGI may assess tax de oficio and suspend the corporate Paz y Salvo.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a private Panamanian S.A. Audited financial statements (dictamen fiscal) become mandatory only for regulated entities (banking, insurance, trusts, finance) and for taxpayers reporting gross Panamanian-source income above the DGI threshold (approximately B/.750,000), or when expressly required by the DGI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Colegio de Contadores Públicos Autorizados de Panamá for public-interest and regulated entities; private S.A.s commonly maintain records under IFRS or US GAAP, subject to the Código Fiscal bookkeeping and invoicing requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Law 23 of 2015 and DGI Resolution 201-0618 of 2021 require every Panamanian S.A. to identify each ultimate beneficial owner holding 10% or more of shares, voting rights, or effective control, including directors and senior officers as fallback, and to file an annual confirmation in the DGI's electronic Registry within 30 days of the registration anniversary. Share transfers and UBO changes require an interim update within 30 days; the registered agent is jointly responsible for maintaining accurate supporting documentation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registro de Acciones (Share Ledger / Register of Members)
Libro de Actas de la Asamblea de Accionistas (Shareholders' Meeting Minutes Book)
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva (Board of Directors' Meeting Minutes Book)
Expediente de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO File under Law 23 of 2015)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 – US$700 per year for a Panama resident agent retainer including the registered office address and routine statutory notice handling
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Generally US$0 for a private offshore S.A. without Panamanian-source income; US$1,500 – US$5,000 per engagement if the DGI threshold or a regulated-activity requirement triggers an independent audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: 0% Panamanian CIT on foreign-source income (e.g., survey fees for inspections physically performed outside Panama for foreign underwriters, provided the profit is not attributable to a Panama permanent establishment). No general CIT holiday for marine surveyors. SEM (Multinational Headquarters) regime may exempt qualifying regional service-center profits and provide ITBMS/VAT and municipal tax relief. Panama Pacifico special economic zone may grant CIT exemptions for qualified licensed operators.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 101 (Informe de Rentas - Declaración Jurada de Renta); filed electronically via DGI T@S portal (https://tas.dgi.gob.pa)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance income-tax payments (Form 105) due 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year taxpayers must file on or before 31 March of the following tax year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC number, full legal name of the S.A., fiscal year, declared ISIC activity (5222) and NAICS code (488390)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident agent must verify the RUC registration is active and the marine claims/survey activity is correctly codified before submitting the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source income from vessel hull/cargo damage surveys, claims inspection reports, and marine insurance survey consulting
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only fees arising from services rendered or utilized in Panama; relate each invoice to the territory where the physical inspection occurred.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source fees excluded under territoriality, exempt income, and non-taxable exchange gains
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain the survey contract, site-visit records, crew manifests, vessel port logs, and underwriter wire/payment evidence proving the inspection work was performed outside Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs directly related to taxable income: marine surveyor salaries, vessel mobilization, calibration equipment, professional indemnity insurance, travel, and authorized provisions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apportion common costs between taxable Panama-source and non-taxable foreign-source income; payments to foreign sub-surveyors are subject to non-resident WHT where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after deductions and loss carryforward (maximum 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source losses may not offset Panama-source income; losses must be traceable to the taxable territorial source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Headline 25% tax computed on net taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify application of any SEM/Pacifico incentive to the tax payable; compute withholding tax credits for local customer retentions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance payments made on Form 105, employer withholding certificates, and other tax credits; resulting balance due or refund request
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the four quarterly advance payments with bank deposit vouchers; attach any DGI-approved 'Nota de Crédito' to the e-filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: monthly surcharge of 10% of the unpaid tax (up to 100%) plus monthly interest of 1.5%; fixed fine for non-filing PAB 100 to PAB 10,000 depending on revenue size; understatement penalty of 20% of the tax discrepancy plus interest. Criminal tax evasion carries imprisonment of 2 to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends paid from Panama-taxed profits; 15.5% on dividends paid out of non-taxable (foreign-source) retained earnings; distributions from share premium or capital reductions are generally non-taxable when correctly documented.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTA network (Netherlands, UK, Singapore, Spain, France, Portugal, South Korea, Mexico, among others) typically reduces dividend WHT to 5%-10% for qualifying beneficial owners. Protocol: (i) obtain an original Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the foreign tax authority; (ii) submit to the withholding agent and DGI a completed treaty-relief/beneficial-ownership declaration and proof of shareholding (usually ≥10%-25%); (iii) file the DGI treaty exemption request at least 15 working days before the dividend payment resolution; (iv) the paying agent must receive DGI confirmation before effecting payment or the agent is personally liable for the unwithheld tax; (v) retain all documentation for 5 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and technical-assistance fees paid to non-residents: 12.5%; interest paid to non-resident related-party lenders: 5% (interest on ordinary overseas bank loans is generally outside Panama-source taxation under territoriality). Treaty rates generally range from 5% to 10% for royalties and interest, subject to TRC and beneficial-ownership certification.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory transfer-pricing documentation and Form 930 (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia) are required when gross Panama-source revenue exceeds PAB 3,000,000 AND cross-border controlled transactions exceed PAB 1,000,000 in the fiscal year; Form 930 due by 30 June following the fiscal year-end.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Requirements (Executive Decree 175 of 2021, implementing Law 70 of 2019) bind Panama-tax-resident S.A.s conducting relevant activities, including insurance/reinsurance, shipping, and group service centers. A marine claims-surveying S.A. that is part of a multinational group, earns intercompany commissions from a foreign underwriter, or books predominantly foreign-source fees must demonstrate physical premises, qualified marine surveyor staff, local board meetings, and core income-generating activities in Panama. The company must submit an annual ESR notification; absence of local substance triggers rebuttal of the 'foreign-source income' characterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission of Panama-source marine survey income while the survey reports, mooring and attendance logs, and underwriter wire transfers (including Wise receipts) prove inspections were performed in Panama; knowingly filing Form 101 that mislabels Panama-source earnings as 'foreign-source' without territorial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 2 to 5 years; fine of 50%-100% of evaded tax; 20% discrepancy surcharge on under-declared income; monthly 1.5% interest; exclusion from public contracts; seizure of bank accounts and vessels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing false or omission-tainted returns are criminally liable and jointly and severally liable for the unpaid 25% CIT; DGI may embargo personal assets and issue an impedimento de salida (travel ban) with the National Immigration Service.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. as a nominee-managed shell: no Panamanian office, no locally licensed marine surveyor staff, no board meetings in Panama; booking all profits as non-taxable foreign-source income while managing claims files from a Panama residence or virtual address.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR administrative fine of PAB 100,000 to PAB 1,000,000; DGI recharacterization of the purported 'foreign-source' income as Panama-source income, imposing 25% CIT plus interest, a 20% discrepancy penalty, and cancellation of the Aviso de Operación (active taxpayer status).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered resident agent face personal fines for false ESR filings; on continued non-compliance, authorities strike off the entity and hold directors jointly liable for the re-assessed tax; criminal charges apply for using the shell to deceive the tax administration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Invoicing the foreign underwriter below cost (or at zero margin) to keep taxable profit artificially at nil; undocumented intercompany payments to a related reinsurer or claims-management affiliate located in a zero-tax jurisdiction; failing to file Form 930 despite exceeding the PAB 3,000,000/PAB 1,000,000 thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI arm's-length adjustment with a 40% concurrency surcharge on the adjusted tax difference plus 1.5% monthly interest; administrative fines of PAB 500 to PAB 50,000 for each missing Form 930 or documentation package; adjustments reclassifying foreign-source fees as Panama-source.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving the zero-margin policy or signing a false Form 930 are jointly and severally liable for the adjusted tax; willful manipulation for tax evasion triggers criminal prosecution and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as a marine claims adjuster or insurance surveyor without the required license from the Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá (SSRP) or AMP registration; receiving and disbursing claimant settlement funds through Wise/underwriter-wire channels without an AML/KYC program, risk assessment, or beneficial-ownership records under Law 23 of 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SSRP administrative fines of PAB 1,000 to PAB 50,000 per unlicensed adjustment and immediate suspension of operations; AML serious-infraction fines of up to PAB 1,000,000 for missing beneficial-ownership records or unauthorized handling of third-party premium funds; criminal money-laundering penalties of 5 to 12 years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the head of compliance are personally prosecutable for unlicensed insurance intermediation and as 'responsible persons' for AML failures; sanctions include imprisonment without parole for aggravated AML offenses, personal fines, civil restitution of misapplied claimant funds, and disqualification from holding corporate office in Panama.
